working_definition: T5d neurons of Hörmann et al. 2020: one of the authors' eight clusters at each stage, assigned to subtype T5d by marker genes; FACS-sorted T4/T5 neurons, 24 and 36 h APF (pupal).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T5d neuron (Hormann et al., 2020). Early during its development, it projects its axon to lobula plate layer 4 (Hormann et al., 2020).

justification: The authors assign the cluster to subtype T5d; FBbt has the immature term for it (defined from this paper), as the stage requires.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 4 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a downwards direction (Henning et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; up to the pupal stage the immature term is used (curator).

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00052262 immature T5d neuron (exact match).
